text:
Palladium Price in 2024
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2024, the LBMA palladium price fell 6.5% between 2024-01-31 ($972) and 2024-12-30 ($909). The highest sampled price was $1,125 in October and the lowest was $909 in December. The mean of these observations was $977. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
